title: GTA 6 Fronts Next Game Informer Cover with New Info and Screenshots

Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 Grand Theft Auto GTA GTA 6 Fronts Next Game Informer Cover with New Info and Screenshots Out on 29th September by Liam Croft 9 hours ago Share: More information on GTA 6 and new screenshots will be revealed next week as part of a Game Informer issue all about the next Rockstar open worlder. The two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, are on the front cover with yet another stylised image of them in a car equipped with guns. "Our 14-page cover story features exclusive interviews with Rockstar Games, plus a dozen new screenshots," the outlet teased today. The issue is out on Tuesday, 29th September 2026. GTAVI is our next cover! Our 14-page cover story features exclusive interviews with @rockstargames.com, plus a dozen new screenshots. Want your own copy of this collectible piece of gaming history? buff.ly/1FAnmzj - Game Informer (@gameinformer.com) 2026-09-25T18:00:11.096Z Related Articles News GTA 6 Fans Crushed as Next Game Informer Cover Revealed Nothing to see here, folks The interviews and fresh information covers aspects like the "advanced" weather system, the wildlife, and how Rockstar went about researching Miami and Florida to create "the most culturally and aesthetically accurate and lifelike world to date". Funnily enough, GTA fans got themselves in a twist earlier this year when they thought a Game Informer issue was going to feature the game — it actually turned out to be The Blood of Dawnwalker . Now, a handful of months later, that Game Informer cover is actually a reality. Will you be buying a copy of the magazine? We'll bring you all the new details here on the site next week, but get excited about what is to come in the comments below.
